title: [Feature][PCP] Support DeepSeek V4.1 SWA bounded replay with PCP
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Enable DeepSeek V4.1 SWA bounded decoder replay with Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP), including cold prefill when prefix caching is disabled.

For replay, each PCP rank keeps the suffix tokens that it originally owns. Replay boundaries are computed from the global request, and attention metadata is rebuilt for the retained global suffix. This avoids repartitioning the replayed tokens and keeps KV slot ownership intact. PCP replay currently requires DP=1 and eager prefill.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Users can combine `--prefill-context-parallel-size > 1` with `--swa-bounded-replay` for DeepSeek V4.1, with or without prefix caching. The release note fragment is included in `release_notes/fragments/19321.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

- Unit tests: 52 passed for replay enablement, global suffix ownership, padding, and attention metadata on the rebased source tree.
- NPU E2E: 10/10 passed on 8 Ascend950DT NPUs with PCP=8, TP=1, EP=8, Model Runner V2, eager mode, and `--no-enable-prefix-caching --swa-bounded-replay`. Cold prefill covered 15, 125, 135, 255, 265, 1005, 1905, and 2505 input tokens, plus a long tail and streaming decode. The worker log confirmed bounded replay for decoder layers 21–39.
- AISBench GSM8K fixed 48 questions: 44/48 (91.67%) with prefix caching disabled; 48/48 requests succeeded. The score and four incorrect question IDs matched the same run with prefix caching enabled.
- Ruff 0.14.0 check and format, Codespell 2.4.1, Typos 1.32.0, and `git diff --check` passed for changed files.
- Full NPU `pre-commit run --all-files` remains blocked by check-tool dependencies: the ARM hosts could not install the required clang-format 21.1.2 hook. GitHub's pre-commit hooks passed on `7dd548025`; the subsequent mypy step reported 11 typing errors. Commit `648bf94c6` addressed those errors. [Run 39537495817](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/39537495817) passed pre-commit and mypy on the new head; CPU unit tests are queued.

Hardware run: 141.61.45.110, Ascend950DT 0–7, driver 25.6.1.b023, CANN 9.2.0, vLLM source `a98247ab4db686ee03c66d5feb3c761e52a2f8ab`. Transparent huge pages were disabled. Full startup script, logs, and accuracy artifacts are recorded in the project validation ledger.
